name: print-social-blogger-infographic-isometric-navy-blue-growth-arrows
title: 'Blogger Infographics' isometric diagram with four platform scenes and growth-percentage arrows
whatItIs: A navy-and-white infographic with a bold 'BLOGGER INFOGRAPHICS' title, four isometric scenes (smartphone blogging, live-stream broadcasting, laptop blogging, street shooting) each with a pie chart and connecting line, and a bottom row of blue arrow shapes showing growth percentages (5%, 15%, 23%, 34%).
whatItMeans: Structured and credible; isometric scenes paired with percentage arrows make blogging activity feel measurable and professional.
techniques: Illustrate each activity as a small isometric 3D scene.
Pair each scene with its own small pie chart.
Close with a row of arrow shapes showing growth by category.

vocabulary.definition: A 3D-style illustration drawn at a fixed angle without perspective distortion.
An arrow-shaped graphic showing a percentage increase.
